dedupe_keys.name: eya def wind yield exchange schema

description: The Wind Energy Yield Assessment Digital Exchange Format is a draft JSON Schema for exchanging wind-energy yield assessment results. The IEC 61400-15-2 project repository publishes field definitions, source files and validation tools to accompany a written assessment report. A producer can encode site-specific yield assumptions and results; a receiver can check the file structure and import the values into another analysis. Geographic coverage follows the wind project described by each file. GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing for the published repository. The README warns that the format is still a draft with incomplete elements, so field names and compatibility may change. A conforming file also does not establish that its underlying wind measurements or energy estimate are accurate. This schema can improve data exchange between wind-farm assessment and electricity planning models. The related catalogue ERA5 record supplies weather reanalysis, not this reporting schema. No assessment file or tool was downloaded.
name: EYA DEF wind-yield exchange schema
notes: G7 G7-1659. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Draft status stated by provider; this is a data-exchange specification, not the final IEC standard text.
schema_summary: Nested fields and validation rules for wind energy yield assessment exchange
